notes: R-G2B-10: kid-facing effect text for Green belt seals #16-20 (Technique Seal format from content/abilities/abilities.json and seals-31-40-text.json). Names and effects come from the S4 table in drafts/planning/S4-self-defense-powers.md; every name is an S4 PROPOSAL and every number there is a guess, so no numbers appear in the text. Each text is one sentence under 80 characters, ages 6-9, hopeful, no pressure. 'Great Counter' is the kid word (S4 still says Perfect Counter). Kid text says 'padded staff' (never the real technique's weapon word) and avoids body-part words. ids are proposed (no #16-20 ids exist in content/abilities yet); the Programmer may adjust at import. effectRef points at the S4 effect and is not final effect JSON. 'flag' marks a line whose wording may change; the R-PROGRESSION-BETA family names may also change any line later.

seals.name: Low-High Strike
seals.text: Your STRIKE adds a quick extra hit, like a low-then-high combo.
seals.flag: Overlaps the Strike 'Spin Kick Finish' (follow-up-kick), which already says 'adds a second kick', and the Double Strike Insight (also `strikeExtraHit`). The three effects are the same kind; ask the Game Systems Designer if #16 should differ, then reword.

seals.name: Arm Bar
seals.text: A Great Counter locks the attacker in place, so it can't block or shield.
seals.flag: Says 'locks' (control, never harm). A Guardian is never locked (R-G2B-09 test), so the line is true for normal enemies only.

seals.name: Slide Away
seals.text: DASH past a swing and your Focus fills up a little.
seals.effectRef: dashDodgeFocus 10 (new). S4: dashing through a padded-staff attack
seals.flag: S4 limits this to padded-staff attacks. Until that enemy ships it works on every enemy's swing (S4 fallback), so the text says 'a swing'. Reword once the padded-staff enemy exists.

seals.name: Wrist Lock
seals.text: A padded staff you disarm does no damage with its next swing.
seals.flag: Until the padded-staff enemy ships, the seal works on every enemy's next attack (S4 fallback), so 'padded staff' is only true for the Bouncy Bopper today.

seals.name: Hold and Combo
seals.text: Every few combo hits give you a short burst of speed.
seals.flag: Overlaps the Wind Step Insight (a speed burst on combo hits). Ask the Game Systems Designer how they differ, then reword.
